sections.heading: 0.1.0-alpha.12
paragraphs: A new personal-alpha candidate from clean main: voice dictation, an updated chat, and reliability fixes.
Moving from alpha.7 requires a one-time manual run of the new installer over the existing program. The old updater cannot read the new channel format; Home does not need to be removed.
Publication and download checks are separate from installation: the installed transition, repair, and restart still require live acceptance.

sections.heading: Checks that the bytes match. It does not replace a publisher’s digital signature.
Alpha
paragraphs: Updates are checked automatically; download and installation require confirmation.

sections.heading: Added
paragraphs: Dictation through the configured OpenAI connection: button-based recording, Stop to transcribe, and Cancel without uploading the recording. Text stays in the draft.
Live audio-level waves inside the input field, consistent buttons, and a calmer interface without permanent status labels.
Connection capabilities and tools now switch through the selected AI provider interfaces; unsupported controls are hidden.
Optional installer compatibility with RTSS for Miggi only, without changing Global settings or other apps’ profiles.

sections.heading: Fixed
paragraphs: The full-package replacement contract separates memory compatibility from the internal Core/UI protocol; source and target packages are checked exactly.
Strengthened checks for post-update state, context preservation, Core connectivity, and connection settings.
Improved paste and multiline input, bounded visible history, diagnostics, and second-install protection.

sections.heading: Known limitations
paragraphs: The EXE has no Windows Authenticode signature: “Unknown publisher”, a SmartScreen warning, or blocking is possible. Do not bypass SmartScreen or disable Windows protection. A TUF signature is not a Windows publisher signature.
Alpha.7 → alpha.12 is a manual transition only from the verified alpha.7 package. The old alpha.7 cannot auto-update to this version; unknown older installations are unsupported for this transition.
Do not delete Home, the program, or protected markers to bypass a refusal. A real installed update, UAC cancellation, recovery, repair, and post-restart health have not yet passed acceptance.
803 offline tests, 26 synthetic UI tests, and 16 document operations passed; that is not clean-PC acceptance or a guarantee for every Windows/GPU or perfect Office rendering.
Technical minimum: Windows 10 x86_64 build 17763. Voice dictation needs a microphone and available STT in the selected connection; cloud transcription costs money.
